step: priority §0.3 — ingest the 180-lesson content package from gannenet-incoming/

deliberately_not_ingested.why: The ZIP ships the pre-monthOf / pre-normalizeSearch versions of these three. Copying them in would have reverted the month fix (commit b3d43aa) and the search fix (commit d8ec075). The existing files were extended by hand instead.

safety_checks_before_overwriting_content.note: Every field of all 52 existing lessons is byte-identical in the new files — a pure superset, nothing overwritten with a rewrite.

defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: 175 of 180 lesson pages prerendered to "המערך לא נמצא" and were served under HTTP 200.
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: params.id arrives percent-encoded; every lesson id but the 61 משלימה ones is Hebrew (p-פרשת-בא), so `l.id === params.id` never matched.
defects_found_and_fixed.pre_existing_scope: 5 of 52 lessons before this package — the only Hebrew ids the app then had.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: lessonIdOf() decodes params.id and keeps the raw form as a fallback for an id that was never encoded.

evidence.before: p-פרשת-בא.html existed, 15332 chars, contained 'המערך לא נמצא'; m3.html 32793 chars, did not.

defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: A select headed "כל החודשים" offered ספר בראשית / שמות / ויקרא / במדבר / דברים and נושא ליבה.
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: 74 of the 119 רגילה lessons carry a unit label where the month is read from — the five books for the 54 parasha lessons, נושא ליבה for the 20 values lessons.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: isMonthLabel() gates the select to real Hebrew months, plus "כל השנה" (an answer about time, and the answer for the 5 משלימה lessons in no single month). Those lessons are found by the new domain filter instead.

defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: סיון and סיוון were two dropdown entries that each hid half of the month — the רגילה files use one spelling, the משלימה files the other.

feature_added.what: תחום filter on /library — the package's own acceptance criterion ("סינון לפי תחום עובד").
feature_added.source_field: tags.domain — the only axis filled on all 180 and free of the meta-line leakage the month fields have.
also: A parasha card had lost both its chips to the two fixes above; the unit chip ("פרשות השבוע — בְּרֵאשִׁית") is now shown beside the domain.
The header counts what is on screen (aria-live="polite") — "19 מתוך 180 מערכים".
The three selects that had no accessible name now have aria-label.

verification.home_page: 180+ מערכים מוכנים (derived from the data, no edit)
verification.pricing_page: reads 180 (derived from the data, no edit)
verification.server: next start -p 3046 on the production build, APP_BASE_PATH=/gannenet

open: /library is 422 kB of route JS: searchTextOf runs in the client over all 180 lessons, so the whole 3.6 MB of content ships to the phone. Same shape at 52 lessons and 3.5× smaller; at 180 it wants a prebuilt search index.
